parent.prior: WSP94 400/400 synthetic goals and 500/500 effect bits, tied independent symbolic and trained conventional; prereg+exact-source Ubuntu/Windows completed. WSP92/93 unused QA DEV remains untouched.

hypothesis: Under partial noisy observation, direct numerical evidence counts plus prospective action selection can identify a hidden causal sensor subset and produce multi-action plans on unobserved interventions, with fixed probe budgets. Compare equal-budget uniform and random policies and fully trained conventional + exact symbolic models. Demonstrate no superiority on accuracy if controls tie. Active selection is not expected to beat symmetry-optimal uniform; that differential is descriptive and must not be claimed otherwise.

world.source: Original deterministic synthetic XOR action world; not real physical dynamics, not causal-confounder identification.
world.hidden_state: Five stable channels are selected uniformly from seven by seeded random generator per world and concealed from all methods. Six opaque action IDs each induce a hidden distinct, nonzero five-bit XOR delta on stable channels; nuisance channels are unaffected causally.
world.partial_observation: Every probe starts from a random original 7-bit before sensor reading; the after reading has true XOR delta on causal channels, plus independently corrupted after reading each causal channel with p=0.12 and two nuisance channels have independently randomized before/after values. Learner receives only action ID, before 7bit, after 7bit. The channel membership, true action effects, and true noiseless intervention outcome are never supplied.
world.noise_prob_12percent: Use random.Random world generator; compare rng.random()<0.12 per stable after bit; two nuisance before/after bits from independent RNG draws. Noise is stochastic observation corruption, NOT an unobserved causal confounder of action assignment. Never claim causal identification under genuine confounding.
world.potential_outcome_protocol: For each action and within-action probe index 0..29, precompute an immutable stochastic potential observation stream independent of choice policy. Whenever a model selects an action, return the next unconsumed potential observation from that action stream. All policies use the same potential outcomes for the same action and nth probe, keeping noise paired. Action choice cannot depend on unseen observations or source hidden truth.
world.evaluation: For each world use all 15 unordered action pairs and 20 unordered triples =35 unseen multi-action goals, with hidden originating action subset never supplied to the planner. Start state random on 7 bits; target = actual XOR of stable causal effects of constituent actions, with nuisance channels unchanged in the intended target. The goal request supplies start and target 7-bit masks and max_actions=3. Planner returns at most 3 distinct opaque actions; score whether true noiseless causal output after planned actions equals requested target. Nuisance observations are not scored as controllable outputs.
world.first_use: No reserved 95101..95120 world generation, model fitting, planning or score before both OS full final qualification at fixed candidate SHA. The seeds are publicly known and thus original unregistered development, never independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS.

candidate.direct_weights: For each action and sensor channel, directly edit integer observation counts n_seen and n_flip from observed before XOR after. No gradient, no learned language tokenization/transformer or pretrained model. Each goal plan uses estimated true XOR effects, computed by majority per action on selected stable channels.
candidate.channel_selection: Rank each channel by the mean absolute empirical per-action flip bias |2ones/n-1| across six actions; select the top five as stable causal channels (tie by channel index). This does NOT use true channel IDs or world hidden effect matrix.
candidate.probe_policy: Take one trial per action first. For remaining 24 of 30 choose the action with the smallest n_seen; break ties by largest average estimated Bernoulli uncertainty p(1-p) across 7 channels, then stable lexical order of opaque action IDs. This is bounded active uncertainty-aware balanced coverage. Under symmetric worlds, uniform should tie; report difference, do not require active superiority.
candidate.planning: Enumerate subsets 0..3 actions using estimated 7-bit effects, choose shortest exact goal if any. If none, choose action subset with smallest Hamming distance between predicted outcome and requested target, breaking by fewer actions then action ID order. This fallback makes actual success rate meaningful even under imperfect noisy estimates; no hidden world access.
candidate.cold_retention: Snapshot counts, original action IDs, observation budget and model counters with deterministic SHA256 integrity; exact restore and original predictions without any replay. Unknown action abstains; repeated unverified observation is rejected via per-action probe index.

strong_controls.independent_symbolic: Independent dictionary of per-action channel count histograms, independent top-5 stability ranking and subset planner using identical 30 active-policy probes; intended exact parity, not independent science superiority.
strong_controls.ordinary_fully_trained: Seven independent one-hot action logistic heads optimized on the same active-policy observed before/after XOR bit labels for 120 deterministic full passes, lr=.6, no extra information. Stable channels identified from learned per-action sigmoid confidence with the same top-5 rule; plan via same candidate subset policy. Report true 7channel signature accuracy, source fit, CPU.
strong_controls.uniform_probing: Same candidate numerical counts with 30 probes allocated round-robin (5 per action); paired potential outcomes, same source/goal budget and overall CPU costs.
strong_controls.random_probing: Same candidate numerical counts with 30 action choices drawn from seed derived from independent SHA256 seed suffix, potentially missing actions, paired potential outcomes and exact same 30 probe budget.
strong_controls.wrong_action_binding: Cyclically shift learned action identities while keeping observed deltas and planning budget; negative control.
strong_controls.oracle_upper_bound: Evaluator-only full true mapping optimal plan using the hidden world; max ceiling recorded but NEVER supplied to candidate or trained comparator.
strong_controls.all_models: No model may access true stable sensor positions, hidden effects, goal generating subset, or other policy's observations. Same 30 probe count (different actions permitted by adaptive vs baselines) and same 35 goals; independent symbolic and conventional receive the EXACT same active intervention observations.

frozen.independent_scientific_acceptance: UNVERIFIED. Passing engineered random synthetic worlds does not demonstrate general intelligence or causal discovery under hidden confounding; equal controls => no advantage.

controls_and_stops: Preregister fixed source seeds and all thresholds in independent commit BEFORE any WSP95 world/model code.
PUBLIC-only first-run 12 worlds; every candidate, uniform, random, symbolic and conventional prediction frozen by SHA256 BEFORE actual outcome scoring.
Engineering PASS on Windows/Ubuntu required; either public positive or negative is a valid experiment outcome. Public negative stops reserved 20 seeds (consumption would be uninformative).
After public positive and source-only three-file G29 atlas reanchor, mandatory full WSP80–WSP95 and complete Yggdrasil root regression on exact SHA BOTH Windows and Ubuntu.

One original reserved DEV first-use, gated after both final platform checks and source receipt, no retries as fresh novelty; never mutate main, official research loop, accepted weights, protected scientific sources, or paid APIs.
